description: Act on one lead inside a sequence (enrollmentId from get_sequence or list_sequence_messages). editText rewrites a message not sent yet. status "active" approves the waiting message when review is on (pass the evidenceFingerprint that list_sequence_messages returned with the text the user read) or resumes a paused lead (approving first returns the text and needs confirm: true); "paused" holds them; "skipped" takes them out of the sequence for good. An approved message is sent on schedule and cannot be unsent.

confirm.description: Set to true only after the user agreed to what the first call (without it) said would happen.

name: update_sequence_lead
title: Edit, approve, pause or skip one lead in a sequence
